title: Operation First Light
description: Establish safe routes through the countryside, city and coast. Ten easy-difficulty operations across eight theaters, all on 40 × 40 maps.

missions.title: Open Fields
missions.objective: Clear the farmstead and reopen the rural supply route.

missions.title: Safe Passage
missions.objective: Rescue the civilians stranded around the suburban junction.

missions.title: Woodland Relay
missions.objective: Capture the hostile relay flag along the woodland approach.

missions.title: Dockside Guard
missions.objective: Hold the port flag while supply crews secure the quay.

missions.title: Foundry Sweep
missions.objective: Clear the industrial halls of hostile fighters.

missions.title: Station Lifeline
missions.objective: Rescue the railway workers and bring them to safety.

missions.title: City Beacon
missions.objective: Seize the hostile command flag in the city blocks.

missions.title: Clear Approach
missions.objective: Defend the airfield flag until support arrives.

missions.title: After the Harvest
missions.objective: Bring the remaining farm workers out of danger.

missions.title: First Light
missions.objective: Defeat the last hostile force occupying the harbor.
